description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'ResetInstallationCommand' used to reset the installation of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to drop databases, delete configuration files, and key files, effectively resetting the application state.

classes.name: ResetInstallationCommand
classes.description: A Symfony Console command that resets the OrangeHRM installation by dropping databases, removing configuration and key files, and providing output notifications.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description 'Reset OrangeHRM installed instance'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the reset process: checks installation, drops database, deletes configuration and key files, handles exceptions, and outputs progress.
